notes.title: Performance Boost
notes.notes:
Good news! The game has been optimized and now runs with higher FPS 💨
Less lag, smoother gameplay, and an overall better experience.

notes.title: Important Update! English Translation + Input Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
input Issues Fixed

Some of you experienced problems with unresponsive keys.
Good news: the input system has been reviewed and fixed!

✅ Keys are now properly detected
✅ Better compatibility with QWERTY / AZERTY keyboards
✅ Improved responsiveness in interactions
✅Subtitles english

notes.title: English subtitles added
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I’ve received quite a few requests to add English subtitles to my game The Door.
A lot of players were frustrated not being able to fully enjoy the game without them.
Good news: in just a few days, an English version of The Door will be available!
Thanks for your patience — it’s almost ready 😊
